definitions.explanation: A decorative design or arrangement of shapes, colors, or lines.
The way something looks or seems; indications of a situation.

examples.english: I bought fabric with a floral pattern.

examples.japanese: ⟦{縞|しま}→縞：27905_shima⟧{模様|もよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.notes: ⟦{縞|しま}{模様|もよう}→縞模様：noentry⟧ = striped pattern

examples.english: This plate has a beautiful polka dot pattern painted on it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方的：17695_ippouteki⟧⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{展開|てんかい}→展開：04542_tenkai⟧{模様|もよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、ホームチーム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{圧勝|あっしょう}→圧勝：07903_asshou⟧した。
examples.english: The game took on a one-sided pattern, and the home team won a landslide victory.

notes:
{模様|もよう} has two main meanings: (1) a decorative pattern or design, and (2) the appearance or state of a situation.

DECORATIVE PATTERNS:
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧{模様|もよう}: floral pattern
- ⟦{縞|しま}→縞：27905_shima⟧{模様|もよう}: striped pattern
- ⟦{水玉|みずたま}→水玉：16173_mizutama⟧{模様|もよう}: polka dot pattern
- ⟦{幾何学|きかがく}→幾何学：16943_kikagaku⟧{模様|もよう}: geometric pattern

APPEARANCE/STATE:
- ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧{模様|もよう}: the look of the sky, weather conditions
- ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧{模様|もよう}: signs of rain
